note: Feature map for tools/release-check.ts (docs/170 §4). Per feature: how to tell it ships on (on.ini / on.tuning; ids that are in tools/release-features.ts take it from there when on is absent), its runtime switches (native = native_set / --ab names in profile-world.ts, fixes = ts3fixes patch names), the code that implements it (paths = whole files; match = regex over the changed lines of the shared files below), the forced repro that makes it act (repro: a repros.json id; loop or hand-written ABBA repros are turned into a fixed-count on-only loop and a bundle ABBA loop; plain repros run as-is for minutes) with the counters that prove it acted ({n} = the on firings), or needsRepro with the reason, and the old release-validate.json jobs (rare, @group) that come back when its code changed: since docs/170 §5 only the jobs no forced path reaches (rareWhy says why); replaces = old jobs or groups its forced loop stands in for (listed in the coverage table with replacesWhy, not run). Mapping is [inferred] from the docs named per feature and the queue notes of release-validate.json; a wrong path or match only moves a job between 'run' and 'skipped', both listed by the tool.
